create.name: Dr. Ginger Lapid-Bogda
create.bio:
Ginger Lapid-Bogda is an Enneagram teacher, author and organisational development consultant who founded The Enneagram in Business in 2004, working from Albany in the San Francisco Bay Area. Her grounding is in behavioural science and organisation development, with a postgraduate degree in education and training in Gestalt practice, and she studied the Enneagram with Helen Palmer and Claudio Naranjo. She has written a shelf of books on the system, starting in 2004 and covering coaching, consulting, leadership, typing and personal development, among them The Art of Typing and Development by Design, which pairs the Enneagram with Gurdjieff's Law of Three.

Much of her teaching takes the form of multi-day certification programmes, run online over several weeks and in person in places such as Singapore, for coaches, trainers, therapists and consultants who want to use the Enneagram accurately with clients and teams. Alongside the workplace material she offers a programme on the Enneagram as a path of psychological and spiritual growth, in which students design a practice suited to their type and work with both desire and resistance. She also runs an online learning portal, publishes illustrated training tools and maps, and keeps a free interactive guide to finding one's type.

books.title: The Art of Typing
books.author: Ginger Lapid-Bogda
books.description: An illustrated guide to working out Enneagram types, using sets of contrasting questions and colour diagrams of each type's ego structure. It underpins her typing certification.

books.title: Bringing Out the Best in Yourself at Work
books.author: Ginger Lapid-Bogda
books.description: Her first book, from 2004, applying the nine types to everyday working life: how each type communicates, handles conflict, gives feedback and leads.

books.title: Bringing Out the Best in Everyone You Coach
books.author: Ginger Lapid-Bogda
books.description: A 2009 handbook for coaches on tailoring coaching conversations and development plans to each Enneagram type. Her coaching certification is built on it.

books.title: Consulting with the Enneagram
books.author: Ginger Lapid-Bogda
books.description: A 2015 book for organisational consultants that brings the Enneagram into each stage of a consulting project, from first contact to change work with teams.

books.title: The Art of the Enneagram
books.author: Ginger Lapid-Bogda and Russell Bogda
books.description: A 2020 visual book made with Russell Bogda that presents the types through artwork and short reflections on awareness, acceptance and change.

courses.title: Development by Design (Virtual)
courses.description: A six-session online programme on the Enneagram as a route to psychological and spiritual growth. Participants map a development path for their own type, practise type-specific exercises, and work with what they habitually resist.

courses.title: Coaching with the Enneagram 1.0 (Virtual)
courses.description: An online certification for coaches that combines the Enneagram with coaching methods drawn from NLP and Gestalt, based on her book on coaching. It runs over six morning sessions across two weeks.

courses.title: TTT The Art of Enneagram Typing and Training (Virtual)
courses.description: A three-session train-the-trainer programme on identifying Enneagram types accurately and presenting the system to groups, drawing on her book The Art of Typing.

courses.title: TTT The Power of the Enneagram at Work (Virtual)
courses.description: An online train-the-trainer certification in applying the Enneagram to everyday working life, including communication, feedback and team dynamics.

courses.title: Enneagram Learning Portal
courses.description: A self-paced online library of slide shows, videos and quizzes on the Enneagram, split into three sections that can be subscribed to separately for a year.

free_resources.title: Find Your Enneagram Type: A Free Interactive Tool
free_resources.description: A free guide on her site for working out your Enneagram type, with pointers on telling similar types apart and real-life examples.

free_resources.title: Free Enneagram eBooks
free_resources.description: A shelf of free e-books on the Enneagram, some in series, that can be read online or downloaded.
